# Generate a Gray-code traversal of all 64 six-switch states, starting from current state 111515.
coords = [(21,42),(31,42),(31,45),(36,42),(36,45),(41,42)]
start = (0,0,0,1,1,0)  # 1 -> 0, 5 -> 1
# standard binary-reflected Gray codes, rotated by XOR with start
states = []
for i in range(64):
    g = i ^ (i >> 1)
    vals = tuple(((g >> j) & 1) ^ start[j] for j in range(6))
    states.append(vals)
seq=[]
prev=start
for state in states[1:]:
    diff=[j for j in range(6) if state[j]!=prev[j]]
    assert len(diff)==1
    x,y=coords[diff[0]]
    seq.append({'id':6,'x':x,'y':y})
    seq.append({'id':6,'x':36,'y':55})
    prev=state
len(seq), states[:4]
